optimizedContext.value:
# Traversal

## Rules

- getUpstream/getDownstream traverse reverse/forward CALLS, default maxDepth 3, 1-index depth groups, retaining shallowest cycle visit.
- analyzeImpact returns target, direct/indirect/transitive dependents, risk, affected files/symbols/processes. CALLS, CONSTRUCTS, USES_TYPE, EXTENDS, IMPLEMENTS, OVERRIDES contribute equally; COVERS_SYMBOL may add specs.
- Risk: LOW 0–2 direct/no indirect; MEDIUM 3–5 or indirect; HIGH 6+ direct or 10+ total; CRITICAL 20+ total or 3+ flows.
- analyzeFileImpact unions per-symbol/max risk and ordered coveringSpecs from batch reverse coverage evidence. analyzeFilesImpact aggregates; analyzeSpecImpact uses DEPENDS_ON/coverage; detectChanges upstream impact.
- Selector: exact case then case-insensitive exact; no text/prefix fallback; ambiguity no traversal. Public exports include exact consumers and canonical dependents; hierarchy honors edge direction/language precedence.

## Constraints

- Stateless domain/services functions; read GraphStore, never mutate.
- Default depth 3; thresholds fixed; no @specd/core.
